text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after I began training with Duramente.
I watched her run every day, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: *Gaaaassssppppp*!!

Every day, I'm more and more amazed by the sheer talent Duramente displays.
Her speed, acceleration, stamina... Everything about her is top-class.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, what a wonderful final stretch.
Isn't my daughter magnificent?
The person looking out at the track with me is Duramente's father. He contacted me asking to observe her training, so I invited him.
He once made a name for himself as a top decathlon athlete.

Her shocking, absolute strength overwhelms all who watch...
Along with her grandfather, who was also an athlete,
she has become a legendary figure.
From her father, and her mother who flourished in the Twinkle Series, Duramente seems to have inherited an abundance of talent.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Talent... Yes, indeed. Dura is, so to speak,
the crystallization of our bloodline.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Athletes who shone in various sports
supporting one another—that's who we are...
And that girl has inherited every bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text: "However, as for me, I want to praise her for her hard work as well."

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Even before enrolling... no, from the moment she first started running,
that girl's training had already begun.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
You must be surprised.
Surrounded by athletes all the time, it's only natural she was influenced quickly.

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text: "‘I will definitely achieve great results, just like my father and mother.’"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...That's her favorite catchphrase.
Isn't she amazing?"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
“Though our sports may differ, as an athlete myself,
I mentored that child... and our entire clan nurtured her
with great expectations and deep care.”

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
That was all her own desire.
...Even as her parent, I can't help but be humbled.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling great today.
Mind if I do one more lap?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text: Heh... You're certainly full of energy.
choice_data_list: It's because I'm in front of my father, whom I've always admired.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly grateful for it.
It really is an honor.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm just as worried, though.
After all, children take after their parents...

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's unnecessary meddling on my part.
After all, she was fortunate enough to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Once again... please take good care of that child, of Duramente.
Training wrapped up, and Duramente's father departed.
choice_data_list: Your dad was really praising you.
Your dad was really praising you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait.
You don't have to say it."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...Ever since I was little, I've watched footage of my grandfather, my father... and my mother during their racing days, over and over again."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Everyone taking on the world...
I'm still nowhere near that overwhelming strength.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's not over yet; the real work starts now.
I can't afford to let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Dura!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Big Sis Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how long are you going to call me—
No, never mind that.

Air Groove—A member of the student council
serving as vice president. Known as the "Empress"
due to her peerless racing style.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Where is Father?
Has he already returned home?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Though I believe they are still nearby.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, in that case, I do not mind.
I merely wished to exchange greetings after so long.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I've known Dura's family for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Dura has been attending the racing school
run by my mother ever since she was little."

Air Groove's mother was also a famous Umamusume who achieved
fantastic results on the track. Her academy has produced
many outstanding Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove has done
so much for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You think so? You were always serious and easy to care for, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose my words
were a bit insufficient, but still.
choice_data_list: Not much different from how it is now, huh.
It doesn't look much different from now, does it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. Quietly doing what needed to be done, she quickly distinguished herself among the Umamusume at the school.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I knew you would come to Tracen Academy.
...I believed in you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thanks to your support,
I've finally managed to reach my debut.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Just like Big Sis Groove, I will become
a magnificent Umamusume who leaves her mark on racing history."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The way you live
is my ideal."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Such flattering words. I have high expectations of you as well.
It seems Duramente holds great admiration not only for her father, but also for Air Groove.
choice_data_list: Well then, I'll head back first.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
?
We can just head back together.
choice_data_list: You'd probably prefer to speak alone with your senior.
You'd probably like to talk with your senior alone, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...However, Big Sis Groove is busy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. I have enough time
to hear what you have to say—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Dura.
How are your studies going?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
I scored full marks on the recent pop quiz as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see, as expected of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure you will manage fine, but once you debut, balancing everything will become much more difficult."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you ever have any problems,
be sure to talk to me right away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Well, make sure that Trainer of yours
keeps a close eye on you too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The ideal you strive for is far too grand.
Therefore, you will likely face many hardships ahead, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Many people, including myself, are watching over you.
Never, ever forget that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll take my leave, then.
...Let's have a proper chat another time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Both Dad and big sis Groove.
They're counting on me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I must win—
Without fail.
